2607.15620.title: AEGIS: Assay-Aware Protocol Validation and Runtime Monitoring for Open-Source Liquid Handling Robots
2607.15620.paper_summary: Self-driving laboratories increasingly rely on low-cost liquid handlers such as the Opentrons OT-2, which ship without the pressure-based aspiration monitoring of Hamilton or Tecan systems and are typically run open-loop. Two failure modes go undetected: protocols that are syntactically valid but violate assay-specific invariants (e.g., tip reuse between a PCR template and a no-template control), and physical execution failures (partial dispense, air bubbles, missing tips) at runtime. We present AEGIS, a two-layer guardian for both. Layer 1 pairs a curated machine-readable assay rule database with an LLM that reasons over OT-2 Python code, reaching an adjusted F1 of 0.97 on a 24-protocol benchmark across five assay families and beating rules-only and LLM-only ablations across five backends; a free open-weight model ties the best proprietary one, so no paid API is required. Layer 2 fits a PCA world model to YOLO-cropped four-frame pipette trajectories; under a leakage-free leave-one-plate-out evaluation it reaches average precision 0.89 and operating-point F1 0.71 (AUROC 0.80), a deployment-faithful number that matches the live demonstration, and we characterize the small-pipette (p20) resolution limit (F1 0.47). A live demonstration on a physical OT-2 (five replicates per condition) catches planted no-tip failures deterministically and partial dispense on coloured dyes, with an always-VLM self-vote gate lifting partial-dispense recall to 5/5; transparent water is a principled limit of any front-view-only monitor, which AEGIS surfaces as low-confidence VLM reasoning rather than a wrong verdict. Cascade triage holds VLM cost near $1.63 per plate versus $10.33 for an always-VLM baseline. AEGIS is open source and, to our knowledge, the first system to unify pre-flight assay-aware validation with runtime visual monitoring for an open-source liquid handler.
2607.15620.paper_summary_zh: 自動駕駛實驗室越來越依賴低成本的液體處理器，例如 Opentrons OT-2，這些設備不具備 Hamilton 或 Tecan 系統的基於壓力的吸取監控，通常以開環模式運行。兩種失效模式未被檢測到：語法上有效但違反特定檢測不變量的協議（例如，在 PCR 樣本和無樣本對照之間重複使用吸頭），以及在運行時的物理執行失敗（部分分配、氣泡、缺失吸頭）。我們提出 AEGIS，一個針對兩者的雙層守護系統。第一層將經過策劃的可機器讀取的檢測規則數據庫與一個能夠推理 OT-2 Python 代碼的 LLM 配對，在五個檢測家族的 24 個協議基準上達到調整後的 F1 值 0.97，並在五個後端超越了僅基於規則和僅基於 LLM 的消融實驗；一個免費的開放權重模型與最佳的專有模型持平，因此不需要付費 API。第二層將 PCA 世界模型擬合到 YOLO 裁剪的四幀移液器軌跡；在無泄漏的留一板評估下，它達到平均精度 0.89 和操作點 F1 0.71（AUROC 0.80），這是一個與現場演示相符的忠實部署數字，我們還描述了小型移液器（p20）的分辨率極限（F1 0.47）。在一個實體 OT-2 上的現場演示（每個條件五次複製）確定性地捕捉到植入的無吸頭失敗和有色染料的部分分配，通過一個始終-VLM 自我投票閘將部分分配的召回率提升至 5/5；透明水是任何僅前視監控的原則性限制，AEGIS 將其呈現為低信心的 VLM 推理，而不是錯誤的判決。級聯分流使 VLM 成本保持在每板約 1.63 美元，而始終-VLM 基線為 10.33 美元。AEGIS 是開源的，據我們所知，這是第一個將飛行前檢測感知驗證與運行時視覺監控統一的開源液體處理器系統。
